crossTitleTriggerFingerprint.interpretation: Official Blueprint help exposes materially different visible entry-trigger structures across titles connected to Jackpot King Deluxe. This does not by itself prove different final jackpot hazard per EUR because symbol frequencies and downstream Wheel King probabilities may compensate, but it directly rejects any assumption that a common pool/profile implies an identical entry rule or identical hazard. Cross-title dominance requires game-specific trigger and downstream probability proof.

currentBestBaseRtpScreen.game: Mega Bars Fortune Wheel: Jackpot King
currentBestBaseRtpScreen.reason: Highest directly verified Botemania base RTP among the operator pages in this evidence pack.

scientificImplications: Shared pool membership does not prove identical jackpot hazard per EUR across titles.
Official Blueprint help shows different visible Jackpot King Deluxe entry-trigger signatures across games, so equal entry rules cannot be assumed.
Contribution percentage is funding flow and must not be substituted for player-level jackpot probability.
If equal final jackpot hazard per EUR were later proven for two titles on the same pool, the higher base-RTP title would strictly dominate the lower base-RTP title before operational frictions.
Operator-page inconsistencies must fail closed until an exact in-game rules/paytable fingerprint is captured.
The published statement that probability increases with pot value invalidates a naive constant or uniform hazard assumption unless separately demonstrated.
